name: Famine
value: Risk of Famine in Sudan; none newly confirmed
summary: IPC warns of rising famine risk in Darfur and Kordofan; no area newly classified as Famine as of 26 Nov
state: An IPC alert in October warned of a growing risk of famine in parts of Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan, driven by conflict, displacement and El Niño drought, but classified no new area as Famine (AllAfrica; IRC). RSF drone strikes killed at least 14 civilians in Blue Nile on 24 Nov, adding to displacement (Sudan Tribune). Searches on 26 Nov found no new Famine classification, so Watch holds.
for_you: UN agencies such as WFP and UNICEF run appeals for Sudan; for travel, follow FCDO advice.
rubric_hit: IPC risk-of-famine alert = Watch; no new Phase 5 classification

sources.title: AllAfrica — Sudan: Drought and war push Darfur and Kordofan towards famine
International Rescue Committee — War and El Niño-driven drought push Sudan further towards famine
Sudan Tribune — At least 14 civilians killed in RSF drone strikes on Sudan's Blue Nile towns

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.

rubric.alert: Famine (IPC Phase 5) confirmed in at least one area.
rubric.watch: IPC Phase 5 projected or 'risk of famine' alerts.
rubric.normal: No IPC Phase 5 (Famine) classifications or projections.
